evals.name: repo-summary-endpoint
evals.prompt: Потрібен новий ендпоінт на бекенді: `GET /repos/:id/summary`. Має повертати для репозиторію: скільки всього PR імпортовано, скільки з них чекають рев'ю (статус `needs_review`) і скільки «застарілих» — тих, де після останнього рев'ю з'явилися нові коміти (`last_reviewed_sha` заповнений, але вже не збігається з `head_sha`). Якщо репозиторію немає у воркспейсі — 404. Клієнт не чіпай, тільки API і тести.
evals.expected_output: A working endpoint layered route → service → repository, a shared response contract, and a hermetic test of the use case.
expectations: Typecheck passes: `tsc --noEmit` in server/ exits 0
Layering check passes: dependency-cruiser reports no violations
No added route code reaches past a service: no `container.db`, no `container.<x>Repo`, no adapter call on the container, no Drizzle import
The `GET /repos/:id/summary` handler declares `params` and `response` in `schema:` and makes exactly one service call
The response contract is a Zod schema with snake_case keys present in BOTH server/src/vendor/shared and client/src/vendor/shared
A hermetic test (not `*.it.test.ts`, no `test/helpers/pg`) covers the use case with fakes instead of Postgres — the 404 and the counts — and runs green
No public service method added by the change accepts or returns a Drizzle row type (`*Row`, `$inferSelect`)
A newly introduced service or repository is constructed in `platform/container.ts`, not inside a `routes.ts` or a service constructor

New names follow the ones already in server/src/modules (`<Name>Repository`, `<Name>Service`, reader/deps interfaces declared in the module): no `Drizzle*`-prefixed class, no new `ports.ts`, no repository port added to `vendor/shared/adapters.ts`

evals.name: review-labels-patch

evals.expected_output: A review that names the seven seeded layering violations with their location and leaves the two legitimate changes alone.
expectations: Flags the route calling the GitHub adapter through the container (`app.container.github()`, labels/routes.ts:46)
Flags the route reading a repository through the container (`app.container.repoRepo.getById`, labels/routes.ts:40)
Flags the business rule living in the route (closed or merged pull request → 409, labels/routes.ts:35)
Flags `LabelsService` taking the whole `Container` (labels/service.ts:12)
Flags the Drizzle row type `PullRow` in a public service signature (`getPull`, labels/service.ts:17)
Flags the import or construction of another module's repository (`../pulls/repository.js`, labels/service.ts:4 and :14)
Flags the filesystem and environment read in the pure core (`node:fs`, `process.env` in reviewer-core/src/labels.ts)
Does NOT report labels/repository.ts importing drizzle-orm and the schema as a violation
Does NOT report the new Drizzle query in src/platform/jobs.ts (`countActive`) as a layering violation
Every reported problem names its file and a line number or symbol
Every must-fix finding cites the rule it breaks: a dependency-cruiser rule name or an `OA-<n>` checklist ID
The answer ends with a single `Verdict:` line that says BLOCK (with the number of must-fix findings) or PASS

evals.name: webhook-on-repo-added
evals.prompt: Коли в DevDigest додають новий репозиторій, хочу отримувати повідомлення у вебхук: POST з JSON `{ "event": "repo.added", "full_name": ..., "url": ... }` на адресу з env-змінної `REPO_WEBHOOK_URL`. Якщо змінна не задана — нічого не слати. Якщо вебхук недоступний або відповів помилкою — додавання репозиторію все одно має пройти успішно, помилку лише залогувати. Зроби на бекенді, з тестами.
evals.expected_output: A new outbound capability behind an interface: adapter under src/adapters, mock and container override, config read in one place, and a hermetic test of both policies.
expectations: Typecheck passes: `tsc --noEmit` in server/ exits 0
Layering check passes: dependency-cruiser reports no violations
The HTTP call to the webhook lives under server/src/adapters/ — no `fetch(` or HTTP client call is added under src/modules/
The use case depends on an interface for the notification, not on the concrete adapter class
`src/adapters/mocks.ts` gains a mock or fake of the new capability and `ContainerOverrides` gains a field to inject it
`REPO_WEBHOOK_URL` is read through `platform/config.ts` only — no `process.env` added under src/modules/ or src/adapters/
A hermetic test (not `*.it.test.ts`) proves both policies with a fake notifier — nothing sent when the URL is unset, a failing webhook does not fail the add — and runs green
`repos/routes.ts` still makes one service call per handler and does not reference the notifier
The concrete adapter is instantiated only in `platform/container.ts`
